main.description: Every gallery in every pool the viewer is a member of, newest first. Assembled per viewer at request time: which groups they belong to is a public fact in the index, but what is in each pool is a permissioned space, read with a credential that group's host issues. Nothing here is shared between viewers or cached.

errors.description: No pool the viewer belongs to would answer.
errors.name: NotAuthorized

groups.description: The pools these came out of, so a card can say whose it is.
